name: RAFT_FAN_BLOWN
meaning: msg 0x14 received since the last update; cleared at the end of each afloat update

name: RAFT_RESET_PROP
meaning: RESET property: Reset moves the raft back to startPos; a sunk raft becomes non-solid (0x400)

name: RAFT_AFLOAT
meaning: set by Init/Reset; cleared when hit with the Wolf aboard (sinks)

name: RAFT_HIT
meaning: msg 0 from CannonBall (0x5F) or WaterMine (0xB1); acted on only if the Wolf is aboard, cleared each afloat update
